details.description: Pythia-12B is a 12-billion-parameter autoregressive language model from EleutherAI's Pythia suite, built on the GPT-NeoX architecture (36 layers, 5120-dimensional embeddings, 40 attention heads) and using the GPT-NeoX-20B tokenizer. This version was trained on the non-deduplicated Pile, an 825 GiB English-language dataset spanning academic writing, web content, books, dialogue, and code, for 143,000 steps (about 299.9 billion tokens). EleutherAI built the Pythia suite primarily to support interpretability research, releasing 154 intermediate training checkpoints per model, and states Pythia models are not intended for deployment or human-facing interaction.
advantages: Released with 154 intermediate training checkpoints to support reproducible interpretability research across the whole Pythia suite, per the model card.
Trained on the full non-deduplicated Pile dataset (825 GiB) using an identical training procedure across every Pythia model size, per the model card, enabling controlled cross-scale comparison.
disadvantages: EleutherAI states Pythia models are 'not intended for deployment' and 'cannot be used for human-facing interactions'; the model was not fine-tuned for conversational use.
EleutherAI's card notes the model may generate harmful or offensive text and can reflect biases present in its training data.
Trained only on English-language text, per the model card.
use_cases: Research on the behavior, functionality, and limitations of large language models, EleutherAI's stated primary intended use.
Interpretability studies comparing behavior across the Pythia suite's model sizes and training checkpoints.

notes: Catalog's kind is 'chat' with a /v1/chat/completions route, but EleutherAI's own card says Pythia was not fine-tuned for conversational/human-facing use -- recorded as a stated limitation rather than contradicted. The GitHub page points to per-checkpoint evaluation files (LAMBADA, PIQA, WinoGrande, ARC, SciQ, WSC) rather than a summary table, so no specific numeric score for the 12B checkpoint was found and evaluations is left empty. The card does not state a max context length, so the catalog's 2048-token facts are not contradicted by any source found.
